description: This file implements the RunC container management class, including container lifecycle operations (create, start, stop, delete), state retrieval, and configuration handling, utilizing the runc command-line tool and JSON configuration files.

classes.name: Runner
classes.description: Handles execution of runc commands such as create, exec, delete, and state, managing process invocation and output parsing.

classes.name: Runner::Info
classes.description: Represents the container's state information, including PID and status.

classes.name: Runner::Config
classes.description: Represents the container configuration, including environment variables for the process.

classes.name: Runner::Config::ProcessData
classes.description: Holds environment variables for the container process.

classes.name: RunCContainer
classes.description: Represents a container managed via runc, providing lifecycle control and status queries.

classes.name: RunCContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Manages multiple RunCContainer instances, providing container creation and lookup.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new container with specified ID and bundle path using runc.

methods.name: Exec
methods.description: Executes a command inside the container, optionally with parameters.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the container, with optional timeout.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the container.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Lists all containers managed by runc.

methods.name: InheritHostEnvironmentVariables
methods.description: Reads environment variables from the host and adds them to the container's environment.

methods.name: Container
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a container instance based on configuration files.

methods.name: InternalPurge
methods.description: Stops and removes the container if it is running.
